label: ナビゲーター（Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign で作ったオリジナルの声）

qwen3.ref_text: こんにちは！今日もいっしょに、英単語の冒険に出かけよう。ポーションは、魔法の飲み薬のことだよ。

design.instruct: A professional Japanese anime voice actress in her early twenties, playing a cheerful game navigator character. Bright, clear mid-high pitch, friendly and energetic but not childish. Crisp articulation, natural and lively intonation, clean studio-quality recording with no background noise.
